name: Qasr Al Ahlam
description: Qasr Al Ahlam, the Palace of Dreams, is Jeddah's most sought-after wedding venue. Featuring soaring crystal chandeliers, hand-carved marble columns, and lush indoor gardens, the venue seamlessly blends traditional Arabian elegance with contemporary luxury. The grand ballroom accommodates up to 800 guests across dedicated male and female sections, each with its own private entrance and reception area. Floor-to-ceiling windows offer breathtaking views of the Red Sea coastline, while the award-winning culinary team crafts bespoke menus featuring both Saudi and international cuisine.

name: Al Mamlaka Hall
description: Al Mamlaka Hall stands as Riyadh's crown jewel of wedding venues. Situated in the prestigious King Abdullah Financial District, this magnificent venue features a 1,000-guest grand ballroom with a retractable ceiling that reveals the desert night sky. The interiors showcase authentic Najdi architecture reimagined with modern luxury — think geometric mashrabiya screens illuminated with golden light, Italian marble floors, and silk-draped ceilings. The venue's culinary team, led by an internationally trained Saudi chef, offers tasting menus that celebrate the kingdom's diverse regional cuisines.

name: Dar Al Uroubah
description: Dar Al Uroubah offers an authentic Arabian wedding experience in the holy city of Makkah. This men's-only venue is designed in the traditional Hijazi architectural style with ornate wooden balconies, intricate plasterwork, and warm amber lighting. The intimate setting is ideal for gatherings of 100 to 400 guests. Known for its exceptional traditional Saudi cuisine, the venue specializes in Hijazi dishes like saleeg, mandi, and kabsa prepared by local master chefs. A welcoming, community-centered atmosphere makes every celebration feel like a family gathering.

name: Layali Al Ward
description: Layali Al Ward — Nights of Roses — is Madinah's premier ladies-only wedding venue, a sanctuary of feminine elegance and floral beauty. The venue is renowned for its stunning rose garden courtyard, where thousands of fresh roses create a fragrant canopy under soft fairy lights. The interior features delicate pink and gold interiors, crystal chandeliers, and silk draping. Specialized services include an in-house bridal preparation salon, henna artists, and a team of female photographers who capture every precious moment. The culinary team offers an exquisite selection of Madinah's famous dates, sweets, and a full wedding dinner.

name: Al Firdaws Ballroom
description: Al Firdaws Ballroom is a welcoming, mid-range venue in central Jeddah perfect for intimate weddings and family celebrations. The recently renovated space features clean modern interiors with warm wood accents, soft lighting, and a versatile layout that adapts to gatherings of 80 to 300 guests. Known for offering excellent value, Al Firdaws provides quality service at accessible prices, making dream weddings achievable for young couples. The in-house team takes pride in personalized attention, ensuring every detail is handled with care.

name: Qasr Al Nokhba
description: Qasr Al Nokhba — the Elite Palace — represents the pinnacle of luxury wedding venues in Saudi Arabia. Located in Riyadh's exclusive diplomatic quarter, this architectural masterpiece was designed by a renowned Italian firm and features a 40-meter domed ceiling adorned with 24-karat gold leaf, a water feature entrance with synchronized fountains, and a temperature-controlled rose garden that blooms year-round. The venue offers unparalleled privacy with separate VIP wings, helipad access, and a personal concierge for every event. The in-house Michelin-trained culinary team creates five-star dining experiences.

name: Rawdat Al Zahra
description: Rawdat Al Zahra — the Flower Garden — is an enchanting ladies-only venue nestled in Madinah's most beautiful district. The venue's centerpiece is a breathtaking indoor garden with a glass ceiling that floods the space with natural light during the day and reveals the stars at night. Cascading flower walls, a central fountain, and fragrant jasmine pathways create a paradise-like setting. The intimate atmosphere accommodates up to 500 guests and features a stunning kosha (bridal stage) area that can be customized with seasonal flowers. The venue is celebrated for its warm hospitality and attention to detail.

name: Majlis Al Asalah
description: Majlis Al Asalah — the Hall of Heritage — is a charming men's-only gathering venue in the heart of Makkah. Built in the traditional Hijazi style, the majlis features handcrafted wooden lattice screens, antique Arabian carpets, and cushioned seating areas arranged around a central courtyard. Perfect for smaller, intimate gatherings of 50 to 200 guests, it offers an authentic cultural experience with traditional oud music, Arabic coffee ceremony, and a feast of regional dishes. The venue preserves the warmth and generosity of Saudi hospitality at an accessible price point.

name: Crystal Garden Hall
description: Crystal Garden Hall brings a fresh, contemporary aesthetic to Jeddah's wedding scene. The venue's signature feature is its stunning glass atrium filled with tropical plants and a cascading water wall, creating a garden-party atmosphere year-round. Modern crystal installations catch the light from every angle, while clean lines and natural materials give the space a sophisticated, Instagram-worthy appeal. The flexible floor plan accommodates 120 to 450 guests across connected indoor and semi-outdoor spaces, making it perfect for couples who want a modern, photo-friendly celebration.

name: Al Burj Grand Ballroom
description: Al Burj Grand Ballroom occupies the top three floors of one of Riyadh's most iconic towers, offering panoramic city views through floor-to-ceiling windows that stretch 12 meters high. The venue combines the grandeur of a five-star hotel with the exclusivity of a private club. The main ballroom features a floating crystal chandelier that spans 15 meters in diameter, while the VIP lounge offers a rooftop terrace for intimate gatherings under the desert sky. A team of internationally experienced event planners ensures flawless execution of every celebration, from intimate gatherings of 200 to grand events of 700 guests.
